name: Wallpaper theme sync
description: After every wallpaper change (Caelestia's postHook), writes the KDE colour scheme, GTK colours and a recoloured Papirus folder theme (caelestia-folders) from the wallpaper's palette, tells running apps to reload, and restarts an open Dolphin so it comes back with its tabs in the new colours (KIBBY_THEME_RESTART_DOLPHIN). Each recoloured folder set is cached by palette, so a wallpaper used before switches instantly. The installer also runs it once, so Dolphin is on the Material style and caelestia-folders icons from the start. Includes the Qt, GTK and xsettingsd settings that point at it.
